articles.title: The Senate has remembered America’s October 7th victims. Now it’s time to heal
articles.description: The father of a soldier killed at Nahal Oz on October 7 urges Congress to act after the Senate unanimously honored all 46 American Hamas victims.
articles.content: On October 7, 2023, my son Itay was nineteen, an American-Israeli soldier stationed at Nahal Oz protecting the border, when Hamas terrorists kidnapped and murdered him. They held his remains in Gaza … [+4296 chars]
